name: dsh-notify-overlay
description: Always-on-top notification overlay for DeepSeek Harness: self-drawn cards for approvals, questions, failures, turn completion, subagent completion and conversation closure, persistent reminders collapsing into a draggable ball, click to open the conversation and bring DSH to the front. Turn the overlay off to get native OS notifications instead, which also works on macOS and Linux · DeepSeek Harness 的置顶通知浮窗：审批/提问/出错/轮次完成/子代理完成/会话结束时在屏幕右下角显示自绘卡片，持久提醒收进可拖动的小球，点击可跳回对应会话并把 DSH 置顶。关掉浮窗则改用系统通知，macOS 和 Linux 也能用。
